page.overview:
Who is Bremondt Freitberg?

Celebrant Bremondt Freitberg is a prodigious wizard who inherited the leadership of Lionel's territory after the death of Cardinal Delacroix. He acts as a secret boss at the end of a sidequest involving Beowulf Cadmus and Reis Duelar in Final Fantasy Tactics: The War of the Lions.

Bremondt born into a prominent Gariland family, having graduated at the top of his class at the Royal Magick Military Akademy before presumably entering the priesthood of the Church of Glabados. Sometime after attaining the position of celebrant and being assigned to the territory of Lionel to assist the region's overlord, Cardinal Alphonse Delacroix, Bremondt met Reis Duelar, a manuscript illustrator, and fell in love with her because of her beauty. Believing he could buy her love with money and gifts, the celebrant tried everything to make the young woman fall in love with him, but she rejected him, as Reis was already in love with and engaged to Beowulf Cadmus, a templar who held the position of captain of the Gryphon Knights of Lionel.

Furious at being rejected, Bremondt became delirious and refused to accept Reis's decision, believing that she could only belong to him. He labeled Beowulf a heretic, stripped him of his post as captain of the Gryphon Knights, imprisoned him, and exiled him to separate him from Reis, but not even that prevented the young woman from loving him. Wanting to get rid of his rival forever, Bremondt prepared a forbidden curse for Beowulf. While he was casting the spell, Reis pushed Beowulf out of the way, and ended up being transformed into a Holy Dragon. It is presumed that after this event Bremondt decided to remain in Lionel, since he did not attempt or engage in any known effort to locate Reis during the years she began wandering confused through Ivalice while cursed.

After Cardinal Drelacroix's death at the hands of Ramza Beoulve, Bremondt inherited his title as Lionel's overlord due to his formation at the Royal Magick Academy. Later, when the War of the Lions broke out and reached its peak, Bremondt discovered that Beowulf had freed Reis from her curse. He tricked the couple's friend, the terminally ill templar Aliste Rosenheim, into kidnapping Reis and bringing her to him as soon as she returned to Lionel. When this happened, Bremondt locked Reis in her chambers at Lionel Castle. Knowing that Beowulf would come to try and rescue the young woman, despite his magickal prowess, Bremondt cowered behind the mercenaries he had recruited to halt Beowulf and Ramza from rescuing Reis.
